senses.definition: n.f.denom. what belongs to a contribution, attendant or secondary contribution, subdivision (on form. v. Köii. 1, 204; strictly adj. (used as subst.), Ges§ 86 h);—ת׳ מִתְּרוּמַת הָאָרֶץ Ez 48:12, of strip of land for priests in Ezekiel’s scheme (but read prob. תְּרוּמָה).
